terminal_failure.exception: ValueError: clean Stage C permits one collected group per snapshot

diagnosis.primary: The integration treated one-update-per-snapshot as one-score-group-per-snapshot. Prime delivered a second ten-record group from the same policy version, and the guard rejected it.
diagnosis.configuration_interaction: group_size=2 produced two episodes per group, while repeats_per_probe=2 allowed a second group. The frozen smoke expected one group containing two episodes and ten traces.
diagnosis.secondary: All context and branch rewards were 0.25. Fourteen of sixteen branch replies failed the exact action-tag parser, and the two valid replies selected the same action. The zero-advantage filter therefore had no usable learning signal even before the second-group exception.

frozen_verifier.result: ValueError: expected one '**/metrics.jsonl' below runs/stage-c/gate-gc-live-smoke, found 0

next_required: Design and CPU-test snapshot lifecycle handling for multiple score groups without permitting more than one optimizer update per policy snapshot.
Fix or constrain live action serialization so branch alternatives produce parseable, diverse actions and nonzero leave-one-out signal.
Freeze a new smoke protocol before any additional model call.
Do not start the three-arm Stage C learning campaign until the replacement smoke passes.
